skill.name: pipedrive-automation
skill.description: Automate Pipedrive CRM workflows for deals, contacts, organizations, activities, notes, products, pipelines, and stages through Rube MCP.
skill.summary: Guide AI agents through Pipedrive CRM workflows using Rube MCP tool calls.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The many external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code around Rube and Pipedrive tool names. The skill does require a third-party MCP endpoint and guides agents through CRM write operations, so data handling and confirmation controls are needed. No prompt injection or hidden executable code was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Third-party MCP service handles CRM access.
remediation.suggestion: Document that Rube MCP is an external service and require user approval before connecting Pipedrive accounts.

remediation.issue: CRM write operations lack an explicit confirmation rule.
remediation.suggestion: Add a mandatory confirmation step before creating, updating, deleting, changing status, adding products, or adding notes.

remediation.issue: Broad CRM list operations can expose large datasets.
remediation.suggestion: Require filters, pagination limits, and summarized outputs before listing contacts, organizations, activities, or notes.

content.value_statement: Manual CRM updates slow sales teams and create inconsistent records. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Pipedrive actions using Rube MCP.
actual_capabilities: Create and update Pipedrive deals after resolving pipeline, stage, organization, and person IDs.
Search or create persons and organizations before linking them to deals.
Schedule, update, and inspect activities tied to deals, contacts, or organizations.
Add, update, and list notes with the required linked entity identifiers.
Query pipelines, stages, and deal lists with pagination guidance.
Map common Pipedrive response shapes and parameter formats.
limitations: Requires an active Rube MCP server and an authorized Pipedrive connection.
Does not provide direct Pipedrive API code or credential management.
Write operations can change CRM data and should be confirmed before execution.
Tool schemas can change, so the skill tells the agent to search tools first.

use_cases.description: Prepare a consistent deal creation workflow that links contacts, organizations, stages, and products.

use_cases.title: Manage Active Opportunities
use_cases.description: Update deal status, schedule follow-up activities, and attach notes during active sales work.

use_cases.title: Review Pipeline Health
use_cases.description: Inspect pipelines, stages, and paginated deal lists for reporting or cleanup planning.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Deal
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow for a new opportunity.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Pipedrive automation skill to create a new deal for [organization] with value [amount]. Search for existing records first.

prompt_templates.title: Update Contact Records
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow for person or organization updates.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find [person or organization], show the matched record, then update [fields]. Ask before making any write changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Follow-Up Activities
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow for scheduled sales work.
prompt_templates.prompt: For deal [deal name or ID], resolve related records and schedule [activity type] on [date] at [time].

prompt_templates.title: Audit Pipeline Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Review pipeline [name]. List stages, count open deals by stage, and identify deals missing contacts or next activities.

output_examples.input: Create a new deal for Acme Corp worth 25000 USD and link it to Jordan Lee.
output: Matched Acme Corp to an existing organization.
Matched Jordan Lee to an existing person record.
Prepared the deal in the selected pipeline and asked for confirmation before creation.

output_examples.input: Show open deals in the Enterprise pipeline and summarize the next steps.
output_examples.output: The response summarizes stages, open deal counts, missing follow-up activities, and records that need owner review.

output_examples.input: Add a note to the renewal deal for Brightway about pricing concerns.
output_examples.output: The workflow resolves the deal, prepares the note content, and requests confirmation before adding it to Pipedrive.

best_practices: Search tools first so requests use the current Pipedrive schema.
Resolve names to numeric IDs before creating or updating linked records.
Confirm write actions with the user before changing CRM data.
anti_patterns: Do not create duplicate people or organizations without searching first.
Do not use broad list endpoints without pagination limits.
Do not assume field names when Pipedrive returns custom hash keys.

faq.question: Does this skill require Pipedrive credentials?
faq.answer: It requires an authorized Pipedrive connection through Rube MCP. The skill does not ask users to paste API keys.

faq.question: Can it create and update deals?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents deal creation, updates, stage lookup, contact linking, and product attachment workflows.

faq.question: Can it delete records?
faq.answer: It references Pipedrive soft-delete behavior for contacts and organizations. Deletion should require explicit user confirmation.

faq.question: Why does it search tools first?
faq.answer: Rube MCP schemas can change, and searching tools helps avoid stale parameters.

faq.question: Can it work with custom fields?
faq.answer: It notes that custom fields appear as hash keys and should be mapped through Pipedrive fields endpoints.

faq.question: What data should users protect?
faq.answer: CRM contact details, deal values, notes, and pipeline data should be treated as confidential business information.
